title: Re-audit frozen B01 Meta signature/hub verify and B12 Stripe webhook signature controls
completeness_claim_narrowing: Inventory covers Meta hub GET/POST signature helpers + Staff API Meta/Stripe webhook handlers + committed IaC/env examples that name META_* / STRIPE_WEBHOOK_* signature controls. Full AST exhaustiveness of staff-query-api.js is not claimed. Live secret values and Azure runtime activation are out of scope (unproven by design).
out_of_scope: any runtime behavior change on master paths
deploy / cloud / database / Stripe / Meta / production WhatsApp operations
live Meta / WhatsApp / DB / Stripe / Azure / network calls
reading live secrets or Key Vault values
implementing the bounded remediation contract in this slice
B02 Meta tenant authority (15G2/15H2) except as post-signature side-effect context

B01_meta_whatsapp_signature_ingress.summary: Source fail-opens Meta POST when META_APP_SECRET is absent (skipped:true) and also when the secret is present but X-Hub-Signature-256 is missing (skipped:true + missing_signature_header). Handler admits skipped results and proceeds to normalize/PostEntry/PG. Staging/sunset Bicep do not declare META_APP_SECRET. GET hub verify falls back to hardcoded DEFAULT_META_WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN. Live secret activation remains unproven offline.

B12_stripe_webhook_signature.summary: Source fail-closes Stripe POST without STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET when SKIP_VERIFY is false (503, no_db_write) before any payment DB. Raw Buffer + constructEvent path is correct. Committed staging/sunset Bicep pin SKIP_VERIFY=false and secretRef the webhook secret. Residual: SKIP_VERIFY=true has no NODE_ENV/runtime-profile startup refuse (documentation-only). Live secret value correctness remains unproven offline.

B01.committed_source_guarantee: None for fail-closed POST admission; skip paths are source-proven
B01.live_activation_evidence: unproven (no META_APP_SECRET in staging/sunset Bicep; no offline proof of runtime secret)

B12.committed_source_guarantee: Fail-closed without secret when skip false; HMAC via constructEvent; skip only when env === 'true'
B12.committed_iac_guarantee: staging + sunset Bicep set STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SKIP_VERIFY=false and STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET secretRef
B12.live_activation_evidence: secret value / endpoint registration unproven in this slice; 15D inventory recorded SKIP_VERIFY=false for sunset-staging as historical deploy evidence only
